messages:
Ivy (Product): Quick one from my biz trip to Stockholm (CONF-2026). I had to bring my 6-month-old due to emergency childcare. I paid for a last-minute infant car seat rental (company card wouldn't process the vendors auth) and extra rideshares (two separate charges) on my personal card. Total OOP ~SEK 1,320. Receipts: vendor provided one PDF lumping seat rental + delivery fee and the rideshare receipts are email confirmations. Questions: 1) are infant travel necessities reimbursable as business expenses? 2) how do I split any combined vendor invoice between biz vs personal (we used it only for infant gear)? 3) Olga is offline; who can approve a family-related exception?

Nina (People Ops): Short answers: we reimburse reasonable childcare-related travel necessities that enable business travel (e.g., seat rental, short-term gear) when pre-approval isn't possible, but they require manager approval and a short people-ops exception note. For combined invoices that only list a total, Finance will accept vendor email + your note explaining items and dates. For approvals while Olga is offline, escalate to finance-approvals@redwood.com and CC people-ops; we can triage up to SEK 10,000 for family-related urgent reimbursements.

Rob (Finance): Adding finance detail: upload the lumped vendor PDF, the rideshare email receipts, and a short description like "infant car seat rental + delivery; rideshares for airport transfer". If the vendor refuses to break out line items, we will reimburse the full vendor gross if its exclusively for infant gear. If any portion is clearly personal (e.g., extra days not tied to work), we prorate by days used for business. We do not reimburse routine childcare costs.

Olga (Manager): I'm offline but saw this thread. I approve reimbursing the infant seat rental and the rideshares related to travel to/from the airport for business. I do not approve unrelated personal childcare costs. Approving now so submission can proceed.

Ivy (Product): Thanks  uploaded vendor PDF + rideshare emails and a one-line note "infant seat rental for travel dates 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12; rideshares airport-home and hotel-airport". Tagging Nina and Olga for approval.

ExpenseBot: Reminder: submit within 30 days. Required uploads: vendor invoice, rideshare confirmations, manager approval (in-thread ok), and short justification. Use tag: "family-travel-exception". Help: https://redwood.example/docs/expenses#family-exceptions
